column1: # The prebuilt bugs binary shipped with the bug-report skill.
# Built per target by CI and by ../setup-dev-env.sh; never committed.
# Rust rather than shell so the register's tools need no shell at all: they
# behave the same under bash, zsh or anything else, and survive macOS retiring
# the bash it ships. A static binary also asks the target machine for nothing,
# which is why this skill's requires.tsv declares no tools.
